title: What's New: Enhanced Power BI and Excel with Business Central (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Five Clicks to Power BI Demo
Power BI Deployment Configuration and Setup
Excel as a Client for Power BI
Calendar Configuration for Power BI Apps
Updated Power BI Apps: Subscription Billing, Sales, and Inventory

features.name: Five Clicks to Power BI Demo
features.description: Simplified deployment of Power BI reports to demo companies with minimal configuration steps. Users can select reports from the Power BI deployments page, deploy them with automatic version matching to their Business Central version, and view reports in the role center.
caveats: Currently only works for demo companies
Recurring refresh scheduling must be done in Power BI workspace

features.name: Excel as Client for Power BI Semantic Models
features.description: Ability to use Excel to create pivot tables connected to Power BI semantic models. Users can connect to Power BI apps via Get Data from Fabric and insert pivot tables for data analysis as an alternative to visual Power BI reports.

features.name: Agentic Excel Capabilities
features.description: AI-powered Excel features that reason over Business Central data for analysis and updates. Scenarios include analyzing financial report Excel outputs, edit in Excel operations, and any reports with Excel layout outputs for data analysis and pushing changes back to Business Central.

features.name: Calendar Configuration for Power BI Apps
features.description: Enhanced documentation and setup guidance for configuring different types of calendars in Business Central that are reflected in Power BI apps. Supports fiscal calendars and week-based calendars for customized reporting.

features.name: Power BI Subscription Billing App Updates
features.description: Full visual refresh and redesign of the subscription billing Power BI app to align with other Power BI apps in the suite. Includes updated visuals for consistency across all apps.

features.name: Power BI Sales App - Customer Retention Analysis
features.description: New capability in the Power BI Sales app for analyzing customer retention and loyalty metrics.

features.name: Power BI Inventory App - ABC Analysis
features.description: New ABC analysis capability in the Power BI Inventory app for item sales analysis to identify highly valuable items that must be kept in inventory.
